build_notes:
Purity of Elements can be swapped to Zealotry if you can fix resistances
- shock immunity from power charge mastery
- freeze immunity from Brine King
- Chill Immunity from Veiled Boots Mod
- Poison immunity from anathema ring implicit or kikazaru
- Ignite immunity can also come from a corrupted ring as well as bleed
- corrupted blood immunity on rare jewel and later a unique jewel (stormshroud with mageblood)

Grafts:
look for crit chance per power charge implicit
maximum life is the best prefix for sure but you can go for lightning pen/crit multi/spell damage
the actual skill does not matter but dont use heart of flame since it delays arcane cloak
